                    prev1 = depot if j == 0 else r1[j - 1]
                    next1 = depot if j == len(r1) - 1 else r1[j + 1]
                    remove_delta = dist(prev1, next1) - dist(prev1, c) - dist(c, next1)
                    k = 0
                    while k < len(routes):
                        if k != i:

                            p = 0
                            while p <= len(r2):

                                key = (delta, c, i, j, k, p)
                                if best is None or key < best:

                if not routes[i]:

                moved = True

        # Inter-route swap
        swapped = True
        while swapped:

            i = 0
            while i < len(routes):

                    while k < len(routes):

                            key = (delta, c1, c2, i, j, k, p)

                routes[k][p] = c1
                swapped = True

    # Final cleanup: ensure all customers exactly once, repair if needed.
    seen = set()
    final_routes = []
    for r in routes:

    missing = []
